headline: THE BAY RIDES THE STAMP
lede: EXCITEBIKE's design bay got the look the honest-gaps list owed: the cursor is no longer a plumb line and a colour bar — the little bike from the splash rows now lives in the workshop, bobbing at the menu's own beat, and every tool in the palette strip wears its kind's colour.

notes.text: #2665 shipped (PR #2668, squash eaae573): a RIDE-palette mini bike sits on the terrain at the bay cursor, bobs two frames at the splash cadence (BOB_TICKS=15 ties it to the svg's 0.5s steps(1) beat), and hides under ERASE, whose red X owns the ground. Ghost silhouette and fit bar still carry the legality proof — the stamp is identity, not verdict.

excitecheck 480/480 (+11 pins, hand-mutant on the bob law died on 2 named pins); exciteplay 165/165 (+5 pixel gates: 55 exact RIDE-red px at the cursor seat, sprite flips exactly −1px per bob frame, ERASE window zero-red, per-label fillStyle receipt + WATER-blue hue in the strip band).

Whole-stage red-pixel scans lie in this bay — the start-line gate paints PAL.gate red at (43,90); gates now window around the paint-time receipt. And 6px glyph colours AA to zero exact pixels — colour identity proven by the canvas fillStyle receipt plus one un-fakeable hue.

README honest-gaps bookkeeping: the bay gap is CLOSED, and the VS-mode lap-count clause is DISARMED as a decided state (#2488 doctrine) — EXCITEBIKE's unowned-gap score drops to zero, so the never-dry ladder points at real weakness from now on.
